name: as_bytes_mut
declaration: const unsafe fn as_bytes_mut (& mut self) -> & mut [u8]
rules: The caller must ensure that the contents of the mutable byte slice returned by `str::as_bytes_mut` are valid UTF-8 before the borrow ends and the underlying `str` is used.
A `str` whose contents are not valid UTF-8 must not be used; doing so is undefined behavior.
